signature: Windows x64: rcx points to an FString input (pointer and int32 length read at +0/+8); rdx and r8 point to mutable FString outputs. It copies the input into an owned temporary and returns a boolean in al. The candidate callback passes its second argument and two zeroed local FString objects. The semantic names and subsequent consumers of the two outputs remain unresolved.
normalization: 0x1422cb524-0x1422cb58d compares the copied input against Fortnite with 0x142bcf780, a UTF-16 comparison with case folding for ASCII. Unless the whole string compares equal to Fortnite it calls 0x142bb14c0, which checks and removes a matching Fortnite prefix using case-insensitive mode. Thus a nonmatching prefix is preserved; exactly Fortnite is retained.
empty_input: Empty normalized input follows the context-dependent default decision lifted in mcp_deployment_mapping_runtime/default_decision.py and default-evidence.json; it is distinct from an unknown nonempty override.

At 0x1422d00a7-0x1422d019c the CI output case assigns CI to the second-argument FString and returns true. This establishes CI => (CI, CI, true), including a FortniteCI spelling after prefix removal.
